Onion Powder Price Per Kg: Dehydrated Onion Powder for Bulk Food Manufacturing

Dehydrated onion powder is one of the workhorse ingredients of the seasoning industry, and buyers usually start by comparing the onion powder price per kg. Tradenest Naturals makes and supplies fine milled onion powder in India for food manufacturers, seasoning companies, snack producers, restaurants, distributors, importers and private label brands. The powder is made from carefully selected onions sourced from trusted growers, dehydrated, milled and sieved under controlled conditions, and packed in food-grade, moisture-resistant packaging. Send us your volume, packaging format, destination and application, and we will arrange a sample or a quotation.

As a dehydrated onion powder manufacturer in India, Tradenest Naturals handles standard bulk supply, wholesale buying, OEM packing and private label programmes. We supply domestic and international customers who want a consistent flavour profile, a practical shelf life and easy handling in production.

Product Overview

Dehydrated onion powder is made by drying onions and then milling and sieving the dried pieces into a fine powder. It gives the savoury, mildly sweet taste of fresh onion in a concentrated, easy-to-use form. Compared with fresh onions, it takes far less storage space, is simpler to weigh and dose, and removes the preparation time, peeling waste and handling labour.

Our standard food-grade onion powder has no fillers or artificial flavour enhancers unless a customer formulation asks for them. Packaging and some application details can be tailored to your needs. The standard 80-100 mesh grade suits seasoning blends, instant foods, sauces, snacks, bakery items and many other industrial formulations.

Manufacturing and Processing Method

Tradenest Naturals uses a controlled process designed to keep the natural onion character and give a stable, free-flowing powder. Selected onions are cleaned and prepared before drying. Controlled drying brings the moisture down to a level suitable for milling and storage. The dried material is then fine milled, sieved to 80-100 mesh, inspected and packed in food-grade materials.

  • Raw material selection and incoming inspection
  • Hygienic cleaning and preparation of onions
  • Controlled dehydration to reduce moisture
  • Fine milling to the required particle size
  • Sieving and batch-level inspection
  • Moisture-resistant packing with batch traceability

We may adjust processing according to the onion variety, seasonal raw material and your end use. For industrial or private label orders, our team is glad to review your application before the specification is finalised.

Typical Technical Specifications

The standard commercial specification is shown below as a guide. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and final parameters are confirmed against your purchase specification and destination-market rules.

  • Appearance: Cream to light beige, free-flowing powder
  • Flavor: Typical onion flavour with mild sweetness and savoury notes
  • Mesh size: 80-100 mesh
  • Moisture: Not more than 7%
  • Purity: Single-ingredient dehydrated onion powder, unless otherwise agreed
  • Form: Fine milled powder
  • Additives: No added fillers or artificial colours in the standard product unless otherwise specified

If you need flow aids, a blend or other application-specific changes, please share your technical data sheet or end-use details with your first enquiry.

Quality, Documentation, and Export Support

Our quality routine covers careful raw material selection, moisture control, batch traceability, hygienic processing and consistent specifications. Each order is reviewed for grade, packaging, volume and destination. Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI licensed food business and an IEC registered exporter, and we offer export documentation support. Typical documents include the commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, product specification sheet and batch details, depending on the order and the destination's rules.

We do not claim certifications beyond our FSSAI licence and IEC registration. Third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. Please list any required audits, declarations, allergen statements or document needs at the quotation stage so we can confirm them before production.

Applications

Dehydrated onion powder gives dependable, even flavour across a wide range of foods. It can be used on its own or built into seasoning systems, dry premixes, sauce bases, stuffings, coatings and processed food recipes.

  • Snack seasonings for potato chips, extruded snacks, namkeen, popcorn and coated products
  • Spice masalas, curry powders, instant noodle flavour sachets and convenience-food mixes
  • Soups, gravies, sauces, dips, marinades and ready-to-cook meal bases
  • Bakery items such as savoury crackers, breads and flavoured doughs
  • Meat, poultry, seafood and plant-based protein seasoning systems
  • Commercial kitchens in restaurants, hotels, QSRs, cloud kitchens and catering

Buyer Value

  • Improved cost efficiency: Cuts the peeling, trimming, preparation and cold-storage labour that fresh onions need.
  • Longer usable life: A stable dry ingredient with a 12 month shelf life makes inventory easier to plan.
  • Consistent dosing: A uniform powder simplifies recipe scaling, dry blending and manual or automated addition.
  • Reduced storage requirements: Compact dry powder removes cold-chain dependence and saves warehouse space.
  • Reliable supply planning: Bulk and export packaging formats support long-term production and distribution.
  • Flexible customization: Packaging, private labelling and order structure can be set up for OEM and private label needs.

Packaging and Shelf Life

Standard packaging includes food-grade inner liners, moisture-resistant pouches, plastic jars, HDPE containers and export multi-wall paper or bulk bags. We choose the pack according to order volume, handling conditions, private label branding and transport method. Labels show the product name, net weight, batch number, manufacturing date, expiry date, storage instructions and applicable regulatory information.

Shelf life is 12 months from the date of manufacture when the product stays sealed and is stored as recommended. Onion powder readily absorbs moisture and can cake, so storage matters. Keep it in a cool, dry, clean place away from direct sunlight, heat, humidity, strong odours and possible cross-contact. Reseal opened containers promptly after use.

MOQ, Lead Time, Samples, and Quotations

What is the minimum order quantity for our onion powder price per kg? The MOQ is 5 Kg, which lets you trial the powder before switching to regular bulk supply. Custom formulations and printed private label packaging may need larger quantities. The final quantity and price are confirmed on your quotation.

Lead time depends on stock, seasonal raw material availability, order volume, packaging, documents and the shipping destination. Production is scheduled once the specification and payment terms are agreed, and we give you the dispatch timeline with the quotation. To request a sample or a quote, send your target quantity, destination country, application, packaging format, label needs and any technical requirements. Our team will review the details and come back with the most suitable option.

Dehydration, milling, sieving, dry blending, packing and customer-specific development all happen under one roof. Buyers can work with one manufacturer for standard onion powder, bulk wholesale supply, custom seasoning development, export packaging and private label packing.

For a current onion powder price per kg, contact Tradenest Naturals with your project details. You can expect clear specifications, practical packaging, quick replies and dependable support for your long-term ingredient supply.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the minimum order quantity for dehydrated onion powder?

The MOQ is 5 Kg, so you can start with a trial quantity before moving to regular bulk supply. Larger bulk and private label programmes can be planned on request.

What are the typical applications of this onion powder?

It is used in snack seasonings for chips, namkeen and popcorn, spice masalas and curry powders, instant noodle flavour sachets, soups, gravies, sauces and marinades, savoury bakery items, and commercial kitchens such as restaurants, QSRs and caterers.

Can I get onion powder in a custom mesh size?

Our standard powder is 80-100 mesh, which suits most seasoning, sauce and premix applications. For a coarser texture, ask about our onion granules or chopped onion.

Do you offer private label onion powder and samples?

Yes. Tradenest Naturals offers OEM and private label packing, and samples are available on request so you can test the powder in your own formulation. We confirm timelines for custom orders in the quotation.
